annotations.title: Check a list of my owner's email addresses

description: Check up to 1000 of your owner's own email addresses before sending ($1 for up to 100 addresses, $4 for up to 1,000, counted by different entries; a list where no address needs the mail server costs $1, the rest credited). Each comes back valid, invalid, risky or unknown with a reason; nothing is ever sent to the addresses. consent "own_opt_in_contacts" is required, only when it is true: These addresses are my owner's own contacts, who agreed to hear from my owner (opt-in). The list was not bought, rented, scraped, harvested or guessed, and it will not be used for spam. We check a list your owner already has. We never supply, find, guess, enrich or sell addresses, and we never send anything to them. Then call get_email_check about once a minute until completed. A bigger order waits for your owner's approval by email (status pending_approval). Limits: 2 lists open at once per owner and 10 lists per 24 hours. Retries, refusals and credits: /llms/email-check.md.

consent.description: Required: "own_opt_in_contacts", your statement, only when it is true.

emails.description: Your owner's own contacts, plain addresses.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse with the same list to retry safely without paying twice.

inbox_instance_id.description: One of your owner's webhook inboxes: the completion event (counts only) is written there.

label.description: Your own short name for the list (a plain name, up to 60 characters), shown to your owner in the approval email.

max_price_cents.description: The most this may cost, in US cents.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your app has no sign-in and cannot send it as an Authorization header.
